prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE modular clothing overlay for an existing cartoon avatar game. Reference image is the required bust silhouette, scale, placement and polished softly shaded illustration style ONLY. Replace its hoodie with GARMENT_DESCRIPTION. Keep square composition and exact reference registration: upper 55 percent of canvas EMPTY transparent; neck opening at x512 y610 on a 1024 square, shoulders spanning x160..864 near y730, garment ends y990. Empty unisex front-facing bust clothing ONLY, no head, face, hair, hands, arms, human skin, body or mannequin. Neck hole is truly transparent. Match the reference's fairly wide shoulders and cropped upper torso, sleeves filled with fabric to lower crop with NO visible skin. Polished dimensional cartoon cloth, readable stitched seams, attractive substantial folds, crisp contours, soft highlights. Technical fabric separation: ALL primary garment fabric in saturated medium CYAN/TEAL (around #278da0); ALL secondary piece fabric in saturated CORAL PINK (around #de647f). Every cloth region belongs to one of these two colors, including highlights/shadows in corresponding hue. Buttons/zips/buckles only small neutral silver/charcoal, no third fabric color, no multicolor patterns. These two colors are required for independent in-game customization. No white fabric or gray fabric, no black fabric, no skin colors, no text/logos, no backdrop, no ground shadow. True alpha transparency around clothing and through neckline. One garment set only, not a sheet or presentation.

garments.dungarees: Denim bib overalls with two broad straps, silver buckles and a large chest pocket, over a short-sleeved crew-neck T-shirt. PRIMARY TEAL: the bib overalls and straps. SECONDARY CORAL: the T-shirt body and sleeves.
garments.quilted_vest: A sleeveless padded puffer vest worn open over a ribbed mock-neck knit jumper. PRIMARY TEAL: the quilted vest with chunky horizontal padded channels. SECONDARY CORAL: the jumper, collar and long sleeves.
garments.kimono: A casual elegant kimono-style wrap jacket with wide sleeves and neat V-overlap front, worn over a simple under-top, tied with a broad textile obi sash visible near lower chest. PRIMARY TEAL: kimono robe and sleeves. SECONDARY CORAL: under-top and obi sash.
garments.poncho: A soft woven poncho with broad draped shoulders, diagonal hem folds and short fringe edge, over a high-neck undershirt. PRIMARY TEAL: poncho and fringe. SECONDARY CORAL: generous folded cowl-like collar and visible undershirt.
garments.varsity: A collegiate varsity letterman jacket with snap buttons, rounded ribbed collar, contrast raglan sleeves and ribbed cuffs, no badge and no lettering. PRIMARY TEAL: jacket torso and collar. SECONDARY CORAL: the sleeves, pocket piping and hem ribbing.
garments.safari: A practical safari overshirt with four flap pockets and shoulder epaulettes, worn open over a Henley shirt. PRIMARY TEAL: safari outer shirt and sleeves. SECONDARY CORAL: Henley under-shirt including its small button placket.
garments.raincoat: A rubberized rain slicker with hood folded down behind shoulders (not on head), large protective placket and toggles, worn open over a high-neck inner sweater. PRIMARY TEAL: raincoat and folded hood. SECONDARY CORAL: inner sweater and visible hood lining.
garments.sherpa: A corduroy trucker jacket with a very plush contrasting shearling collar and plush inner facing, buttoned on lower chest, distinctive vertical corduroy ribs and small chest pockets. PRIMARY TEAL: corduroy jacket torso and sleeves. SECONDARY CORAL: all fuzzy shearling collar and lining.
garments.sweater_vest: A neat knitted V-neck sweater vest worn over a long-sleeved collared Oxford shirt, visible shirt collar above V and shirt sleeves at sides. PRIMARY TEAL: cable-knit sweater vest. SECONDARY CORAL: Oxford shirt, collar and sleeves.
garments.bow_blouse: An elegant blouse with lightly puffed long sleeves, fitted shoulders and a generous pussy-bow/lavalliere tie at the throat, no skin visible. PRIMARY TEAL: blouse body and sleeves. SECONDARY CORAL: the large tied fabric bow and its two hanging ribbons.
garments.waistcoat: A tailored buttoned waistcoat worn over an open-collar long-sleeved linen shirt with gently gathered sleeves, no necktie, no jacket. PRIMARY TEAL: fitted waistcoat with two small welt pockets. SECONDARY CORAL: linen shirt, collar and sleeves.
garments.track_jacket: A retro sports track jacket with stand-up zip collar, broad contrasting shoulder yoke and two clean side panels, worn closed. PRIMARY TEAL: central jacket torso and sleeves. SECONDARY CORAL: shoulder yoke, stand collar, sleeve stripes and side panels. No badges or brand marks.
